title: Roll nested subgraph spend into the parent budget
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He sets `environment.budget.soft_limit` to 2 and runs `run_budgeted_graph` with nest enabled so child node costs share the parent ledger. After soft wind-down, the later parent step is cancelled. [^insp-budget-rollup]
implementation: `Budget.child()` / nested `GraphExecutor` spend rollup. Product verb `run_budgeted_graph` with `nest: true`; story `environment.budget` binds the policy.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `child_rollup.yaml` drives nested `run_budgeted_graph`; expects soft_exhausted / after_status cancelled.

footnotes.label: Inspiration dynamic subgraphs + budgets
footnotes.note: Req 3 nested graphs share observable resource ceilings with the parent
